transcript.content: I'm really struggling with these episodes where I eat huge amounts of food in one sitting. Once I start, I feel like I completely lose control and just can't stop myself.
After these episodes of eating large amounts of food, do you ever try to get rid of the calories by vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things to get rid of the food. I've never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or exercise excessively afterward.
How often do these episodes of eating large amounts of food happen, and have you noticed any pattern or trigger that leads to them?

These episodes have been happening at least once a week, and it's been going on like this for about 10 months now. As for triggers or patterns, I'm really not sure and haven't noticed anything specific.
Do you experience significant distress, guilt, or shame after these binge-eating episodes, or do they affect your daily life and relationships in any way?
I'm not quite sure how to describe my feelings after these episodes happen. I'm also not really sure how they affect my relationships or daily life right now.

Can you tell me more about what you mean by not being sure how to describe your feelings after these episodes, and have you noticed any changes in your mood or self-perception over the past 10 months?

I'm just not quite sure how to describe my feelings after the episodes, as it's hard to put into words. I also haven't really thought about or noticed any specific changes in my mood or how I see myself over the past 10 months.

Have you ever experienced any other symptoms like feeling extremely hungry all the time, eating until you're uncomfortably full, or eating alone because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?
Yes, I definitely eat alone because I feel so embarrassed by how much I am eating. I don't really experience constant extreme hunger, and I'm not sure about the other symptoms you mentioned.

Can you describe a typical episode of binge eating in more detail, such as what foods you usually eat, how quickly you eat, and whether you feel like you're eating in response to any emotional states or cravings?

When these episodes happen, I eat a very large amount of food much more rapidly than normal. I feel a complete loss of control, like I just can't stop eating once I begin. I'm not really sure about specific food types or emotional triggers, though.
Have you noticed any significant impact on your physical health, such as weight gain or other health problems, as a result of these binge-eating episodes?
I haven't really noticed any major physical health problems or significant impacts from this. I'm not really sure if I've gained weight or if there are other physical changes.
Is there anything else you'd like to share or discuss about your eating habits or overall well-being that might help me better understand your situation?

Ultimately, my main struggle is that I eat much faster than normal during these episodes and prefer to eat alone because I'm so embarrassed by how much I consume. It is really hard to deal with, especially since this has been happening at least once a week for about 10 months now. I just feel completely powerless when I lose control like this.
